verdict.rationale: Letta is an agent platform with an SDK, an App Server, and cloud hosting, not only a coding agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only MCP client support (the SDK consuming servers passed via mcpServers), adjacent exposure through ACP and an OpenAI-compatible API, and a community-built Letta-MCP-server. None of these is an official first-party MCP server that other agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
